basic_details.job_title: KVIC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Technical Expert, Marketing Expert and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), State Office Ranchi (Jharkhand) has invited applications for Technical Expert, Marketing Expert, and Retired Bank Official posts on a contract basis up to 31 March 2027. Eligible applicants can apply offline by downloading the application format and submitting the completed form to the State Director, Khadi and Village Industries Commission, State Office Ranchi, 191-C, Vidyalay Marg, Ashok Nagar on or before 27 October 2026 under advertisement number SO/KVIC/Ranchi/PMEGP-B&FL/2026-27. Qualifications and maximum age limits vary by post. The pay is

Experience: Experience in different Village industries, MSME, Handicrafts, Cottage etc., or retired officials of KVIC, KVIB, DIC, MSME DI, NSIC and COIR Board not below the rank of Assistant Director. Strong written and verbal communication skills of local language of the State besides official language. Knowledge of Machinery/Raw Material/Production process/ Identification of potential activities in the respective areas and knowledge on the PMEGP Scheme, Guidelines and procedure. Age Limit: Maximum Age - 65 years. | Qualification: Bachelor's degree in business administration/ marketing/ communications, or graduate in any discipline with 5 years' experience in the relevant field preferably for Small Scale & Village Industry, Handicraft, etc. OR MBA (Marketing) with 2 years' experience in the relevant field preferably for Small Scale & Village Industry, Handicraft, etc. Experience: Previous experience in sales, marketing, advertising, and brand management, excellent analytical skills and data analysis, strong written and verbal communication skills, extensive knowledge of current and relevant markets in rural India for Village or cottage industry, and should be well-versed in local language. Age Limit: Maximum Age - 40 years. | Qualification: Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Age Limit: Maximum Age - 65 years.

content_sections.heading: KVIC Technical Expert Job Description
content_sections.text: Technical Expert Responsibilities: To act as mentor for units setup under PMEGP, provide handholding support to the new and old entrepreneurs, guide prospective entrepreneurs to establish viable projects and about PMEGP Scheme benefits and procedure, provide guidance on modern technology processes and management practices, and regular monitoring of progress made. Marketing Expert Responsibilities: Develop, implement, and track marketing programs such as email, social media, or digital campaigns, and events; collaborate with other internal teams to develop and monitor strategic marketing initiatives; analyze and report on the performance and efficiency of campaigns; conduct market research and analyze trends to identify new marketing opportunities; develop and create marketing materials, such as sales and product collateral; write, proofread, and edit creative and technical content across different mediums; work with external agencies and vendors to execute marketing programs; excellent time management; and ability to travel as necessary. Retired Bank Official Responsibilities: Provide handholding support to the new and old entrepreneurs, guide prospective entrepreneurs to establish viable projects, help in preparation of detailed project reports and other related documents to reduce rejection from financing banks, reduce time to market by streamlining application process, and regular monitoring of progress made.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification states that selection is for appointment on a contract basis up to 31.03.2027, which may be extended based on the performance of the selected candidates. The official notification does not outline a detailed written examination or interview process stages beyond application scrutiny based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KVIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 27.10.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for Technical Expert?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Technical Expert is 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Marketing Expert?
faq.answer: Applicants require a Bachelor's degree in business administration/marketing/communications or a graduate degree with 5 years of experience, or an MBA (Marketing) with 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration for Technical Expert?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply offline by downloading the application format and submitting it by post to the State Office Ranchi address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contract basis up to 31.03.2027, which may be extended based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. What are the eligibility criteria for Retired Bank Officials?
faq.answer: Retired Bank Officials must hold a Bachelor's degree in any discipline with 15 years of banking experience, including a minimum of 3 years as a Branch Manager, and be up to 65 years of age.
